M152 uses deterministic lower-bound discovery and explicitly frozen score populations; the integrated M151 adjudication promotes its former seven raw cap labels to fixed_subsample with no verdict flip. Its supplemental clean-noise surrogate and synthetic mutation battery are fixture evidence; their 500 frozen sites and eleven temporal pair clusters are explicitly disclosed and are not generalized to independent capture prevalence.
